issue.title: Strange `.Validator` behavior

comments.author: tarampampam
comments.body:
I would be extremely grateful if you could decide that the flag value should be validated only after parsing, once the default value has been replaced by the one provided by the user, but before allowing the developer to use it. Additionally, when the --help flag is used, no validation should be performed. I believe this is critically important

P.s. and thank you @dearchap for supporting this package, you're doing the tremendous work!
